deps.reason: Each matrix entry is defined from the repository tree pairing.
The Gram matrix is indexed by the vertex-vector basis.

origin.note: Supports the rational scalar-extended Gram/capacity setting.

nl.text: For a finite integer-weighted simple graph `G` with weight function `w`, define `rootedGram G w` as the rational matrix indexed by the vertices of `G` whose `(u, v)` entry is the integer value `treePairing G w (vertexVector u) (vertexVector v)` coerced to `ℚ`.  It is therefore the exact rational scalar extension of the repository tree pairing in the vertex-vector basis.
